setup: You are given one of the two ratios and asked for the other using $\sin^{2}\theta + \cos^{2}\theta = 1$.

steps.say: The identity comes straight from the unit circle, where the horizontal and vertical distances square to 1 — so the two squared ratios always add to 1.
That leaves [[rem_num]]/[[sq_den]], so [[want]] = √([[rem_num]]/[[sq_den]]). Taking the positive root is what the assumption that the angle is acute buys you.
